base: Create exactly one macOS app icon for MyToolBox's unified blue utility icon family. Front-facing orthographic glossy royal-blue rounded-square enamel tile with thick softly beveled rim, subtle cyan upper-left highlight, deeper cobalt bottom, transparent outside tile. Center one large bold tactile 3D object occupying about 70% of tile. Rounded friendly premium materials, clean silhouette legible at 32px, simple details, soft upper-left studio lighting, restrained shadow. Consistent generous margins. prototypeBase: Create one polished macOS app icon prototype for the MyToolBox utility family. Single centered rounded-square blue enamel tile, softly beveled edges, restrained premium tactile 3D illustration matching a glossy blue toolbox app family. Straight-on orthographic view, large simple foreground object, clear silhouette readable at 32px, generous consistent margins, soft upper-left studio lighting, subtle grounded shadow. No text, no letters, no watermark, no other icons, no mockup device. Transparent outside the rounded-square tile.
